item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Harun's lifting electromagnet on a crane. A coil on an iron core is joined to a cell through a switch. Iron scrap sits under the electromagnet. A plastic button sits nearby.

Which prediction is correct?

options.A: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron scrap. Switch OFF: it releases the iron scrap.
options.B: Switch ON: the electromagnet releases the iron scrap. Switch OFF: it picks up the iron scrap.
options.C: Switch ON: the electromagnet picks up the iron scrap and the plastic button.
options.D: Switch OFF: the electromagnet keeps holding the iron scrap as strongly as when the switch was ON.
